title: Spicy Shakshuka
subtitle: with fresh chilli and tomatoes
description: A fiery shakshuka with green chilli, red chilli and hot paprika, made with fresh tomatoes. Use capsicum instead of the red chillies for a milder version.

steps.text: Heat the oil in a wide frying pan.
Add the long green chilli, green chillies and red chillies and fry over medium heat for 4-5 minutes, until they start to soften.
Add the thinly sliced garlic and fry for another minute, just until fragrant.

Peel and dice the tomatoes. Add them with the sugar, stir well and cook over medium-high heat for 30-40 minutes, until the tomatoes break down into a thick sauce and most of the liquid has reduced. Stir occasionally so it doesn't burn.
Add the sweet paprika, hot paprika and salt, stir well and cook for another 3-5 minutes.
Make wells in the sauce and crack in the eggs. Cover the pan and cook to your liking.
Sprinkle with chopped parsley and serve immediately with fresh bread.
